admissions.operation: Ensure meal-level protein supply delivers the amino-acid foundation neurotransmitter pathways depend on.

scientific_assessment.operation: Ensure meal-level protein supply delivers the amino-acid foundation neurotransmitter pathways depend on.

functional_dependency.statement: The defined indispensable set must be supplied by diet and supports circulating amino-acid availability. The accepted PM relationship concerns coverage, not increased brain synthesis.

dietary_supply.statement: The canonical milk record explicitly documents a complete essential-amino-acid profile with FAO provenance. A qualitative complete-set edge does not infer quantities from total protein.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Identity reconciliation of the already accepted class; no new requirement that each meal provide all nine, no uniform digestibility or neurotransmitter benefit.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing canonical Milk text explicitly supports the complete set. Record that supported qualitative relationship; no food is inferred from total protein and no nine-fold multiplication of admissions or amounts is performed. Other full-profile food edges require separate verified composition.

admissions.biological_role: Coverage of the indispensable amino-acid set, including phenylalanine, that sets the circulating pool neurotransmitter pathways can draw on. Meals contribute measurable amino-acid composition; this is not a requirement that each meal provide complete coverage
admissions.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
admissions.limitation: Protein-quality scoring and vegetarian-diet amino-acid coverage do not establish that increasing protein raises brain monoamine synthesis or improves attention or mood. The indispensable set includes phenylalanine; tyrosine is not an indispensable amino acid.
admissions.qualification: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.

admissions.operation: Ensure meal-level protein supply delivers the amino-acid foundation neurotransmitter pathways depend on.

scientific_assessment.operation: Ensure meal-level protein supply delivers the amino-acid foundation neurotransmitter pathways depend on.

functional_dependency.statement: Dietary tyrosine supplies the circulating tyrosine precursor pool, alongside endogenous phenylalanine hydroxylation, sustaining substrate availability for downstream pathways.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral has established dietary supply through the canonical composition records. Cellular uptake and homeostasis mediate enzyme loading; this is maintenance of capacity, not a claim that extra intake accelerates the reaction.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: Dietary supply to a circulating pool is distinct from brain transport, catecholamine synthesis or clinical benefit. A small human study found higher plasma tyrosine during protein-containing meals and after a large tyrosine supplement; it does not define ordinary-food efficacy or a need for extra tyrosine when supply is adequate. Tyrosine is not an indispensable amino acid.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Inspected existing structured composition records and provisional research coverage for the same mineral. Verified plant/animal sources are reused with preparation qualifiers; no new food edge, effective food dose or enzyme-response inference is created.

admissions.biological_role: Catecholamine precursor in the circulating pool this PM prioritises. Tyrosine is normally formed from indispensable phenylalanine and can become conditionally indispensable when phenylalanine availability is limited
admissions.dietary_input_note: 2026-10-26 recovery: admitted Type A capacity under the functional-dependency and dietary-supply gate. The original biochemical-only record and its rationale are preserved in the recovery history. No additional-intake efficacy is asserted.

admissions.limitation: Competitive transport biology does not establish that eating more tyrosine increases brain tyrosine or catecholamine signalling.

admissions.biological_role: The reviewed pool supplies tyrosine for the dopamine synthesis reaction. The individual tyrosine disclosure is retained in Direct Requirements above; this KC record preserves its upstream provenance without a second copy. Individually reviewed phenylalanine-to-tyrosine conversion also replenishes that precursor supply.
admissions.dietary_input_note: Pool/constraint reference; constituent dietary supply is recorded separately.
admissions.limitation: Only tyrosine supply is admitted here. Phenylalanine publication awaits its individual source/context appraisal; tryptophan is not admitted as catecholamine supply. Competitive inadequacy as a limiting constraint remains unresolved.

admissions.biological_role: [BRS2 PM1 — Folate/B12 remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm1-folate-b12-dependent-homocysteine-remethylation) and [BRS2 PM2 — Betaine/BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation) replenish methionine used by [BRS2 PM3 — SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis); COMT uses SAM during dopamine metabolism.
admissions.dietary_input_note: Pool/constraint reference; constituent dietary supply is recorded separately.
admissions.limitation: This establishes the connected biochemical supply route, not a measured dietary effect on regional neural SAM or COMT clearance. BHMT is predominantly hepatic/renal; peripheral methionine contribution, local SAM synthesis, alternative supply and turnover vary by tissue. Donor inadequacy as a limiting constraint and benefit from extra intake in replete individuals remain unresolved.
admissions.qualification: Pool reference; no nutrient quantity added.

A limiting effect and benefit from extra intake remain unresolved.

admissions.biological_role: The reviewed pool presents tyrosine through [BRS1 PM2 — LAT1 transport](/docs/biological-targets/brs1/fm1/brs1-fm1-pm2-lat1-competitive-transport-modulation), upstream of dopamine formation and its conversion to noradrenaline. Individually reviewed phenylalanine-to-tyrosine conversion also replenishes that precursor supply.
admissions.dietary_input_note: Pool/constraint reference; constituent dietary supply is recorded separately.
admissions.limitation: Only tyrosine supply is admitted here. Phenylalanine publication awaits its individual source/context appraisal; tryptophan is not admitted as catecholamine supply. Competitive inadequacy as a limiting constraint remains unresolved.
admissions.qualification: Pool reference; no nutrient quantity added.

admissions.biological_role: [BRS2 PM1 — Folate/B12 remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm1-folate-b12-dependent-homocysteine-remethylation) and [BRS2 PM2 — Betaine/BHMT remethylation](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm2-betaine-bhmt-remethylation) replenish methionine used by [BRS2 PM3 — SAM synthesis](/docs/biological-targets/brs2/fm1/brs2-fm1-pm3-same-synthesis); COMT uses SAM during noradrenaline metabolism.
admissions.dietary_input_note: Pool/constraint reference; constituent dietary supply is recorded separately.
admissions.limitation: This establishes the connected biochemical supply route, not a measured dietary effect on regional neural SAM or COMT clearance. BHMT is predominantly hepatic/renal; peripheral methionine contribution, local SAM synthesis, alternative supply and turnover vary by tissue. Donor inadequacy as a limiting constraint and benefit from extra intake in replete individuals remain unresolved.
admissions.qualification: Pool reference; no nutrient quantity added.

admissions.biological_role: The reviewed LNAA pool presents tyrosine through [BRS1 PM2 — LAT1 transport](/docs/biological-targets/brs1/fm1/brs1-fm1-pm2-lat1-competitive-transport-modulation) for synthesis of dopamine, the immediate precursor converted by DBH into noradrenaline.
admissions.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
admissions.limitation: Tyrosine is upstream precursor supply, not the immediate DBH substrate or an independently adjudicated Direct dietary requirement here. Ordinary dietary competitive changes do not establish a limiting effect on regional noradrenergic signalling or benefit from extra tyrosine.
admissions.qualification: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.

SAM is the methyl donor used by COMT during noradrenaline metabolism.
admissions.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.

admissions.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.

SAM is used by COMT during noradrenaline metabolism.
admissions.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.
admissions.limitation: Only choline-to-betaine methyl supply is admitted, not membrane or acetylcholine roles. Hydroxylation, renal/hepatic function and LNAA competition matter; high phenylalanine is not interchangeable with tyrosine.

admissions.dietary_input_note: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added.

Donor inadequacy as a limiting constraint, compensation and benefit from extra intake remain unresolved.
admissions.qualification: Accepted dietary provision or constituent supply relationship; no efficacy or quantity claim added. Supported upstream resource supply; not reclassified as limiting iKC applicability.
